add_card-label: Ask about adding existing board labels to a card and use remove_card-label to remove one.
comment_card: Ask about posting comments on a card and use list_card-action to read comment history.
create_board-label: Answers 'create label X on board Y' and 'add a colored label' by making a new label with name and color. For existing labels use list_board-label.
create_card: Ask about creating cards in lists from text or a URL and use set_card to change existing cards.
create_card-attachment: Ask about attaching URL files to a card or setting a cover and use list_card-attachment to see existing attachments.
create_card-checklist: Ask about adding or copying checklists to a card and use list_card-checklist to see existing ones.
create_checklist-item: Question shapes: 'add an item called X to checklist Y', 'add a checked item due Monday', 'add an item assigned to Sam'. Creates a checklist item with name and optional due date, member, or checked state. For updating an item use set_card-checkitem.
create_list: Question shapes: 'create a list called X on board Y', 'add a new column at position 2', 'copy list X into a new list'. Creates a list with name and position and optional copy source. For rename or archive use set_list.
delete_board-label: IRREVERSIBLE. Deletes the label everywhere, stripping it from every card that carries it across the whole board. To take a label off one card, use remove_card_label instead.
delete_card-attachment: IRREVERSIBLE. Trello has no archived state for an attachment, so this is the only way to take one off a card.
delete_checklist: IRREVERSIBLE. Removes the checklist and every item on it. Checklists have no archived state.
delete_checklist-item: IRREVERSIBLE. Check items have no archived state. To mark one done instead, use set_card-checkitem with state=complete.
get_board: Answers 'get board details', 'what is the board URL', and 'is this board closed' for one board by id. For edits like rename or archive use set_board.
get_card: Ask about card details like "Show me card X" or "What are the dates on card Y?" and use set_card for edits.
get_checklist: Answers 'what checklist is X', 'which card has checklist X', and 'show checklist X with its card'. Returns one checklist by id with items and owning card. For checked state of items use list_checklist-item.
get_list: Answers 'what list is this', 'is this column archived', and 'which board is this list on'. Returns one list's name, board, closed flag, and position by id. For cards in it use list_list-card.
list_board-card: Answers 'show cards on board X', 'open cards on board X', and 'archived cards on board X' for one board. For cards grouped by column use list_board-list.
list_board-checklist: Answers 'checklists on board X' and 'all checklists across cards on board X'. For the cards themselves use list_board-card.
list_board-label: Answers 'labels on board X' and 'what colors are labels on board X' with name and color. To create a new label use create_board-label.
list_board-list: Answers 'list columns on board X', 'show open lists on board X', and 'lists with cards on board X'. For cards across the whole board use list_board-card.
list_board-member: Answers 'who is on board X' and 'show board members for X'. For which boards you can see use list_my-board.
list_card-action: Ask about card activity, moves, updates, or comments and use comment_card to post comments.
list_card-attachment: Ask what attachments are on a card and use create_card-attachment to add a URL.
list_card-checklist: Ask what checklists and items are on a card and use create_card-checklist to add a checklist.
list_card-custom-field: Ask what custom field values are set on a card and use get_card for general card details.
list_card-member: Ask who is assigned to a card and use set_card to change the members.
list_checklist-item: Answers 'what is on this checklist', 'show completed items', 'which items are still open'. Returns checklist items with complete or incomplete state. For updating an item's state use set_card-checkitem.
list_list-card: Answers 'what cards are in this list', 'show open cards in column X', and 'any closed cards in list Y'. Returns cards for one list with an open, closed, or all filter. For list details use get_list.
list_my-board: Answers 'which boards can I see' and 'show my open or closed boards' by listing boards with optional lists and organization. For one board's fields use get_board.
mcp_beaver_info: Report this MCP server's identity, mode, and served tool inventory. Read-only, reaches no upstream, and doubles as a liveness probe now that the protocol ping is gone.
remove_card-label: Ask about removing one label from a card and use add_card-label to attach a label.
search_trello: Answers 'find cards about X' and 'search boards for Y' across boards, cards, members, and organizations with model filters. For all cards on one board use list_board-card.
set_board: Answers 'rename board X', 'archive or unarchive board X', 'update board description', and 'subscribe to board X' by board id. For current details use get_board.
set_card: Ask about moving, editing, archiving, or assigning a card and use get_card to read the card.
set_card-checkitem: Answers 'check off this checklist item', 'rename checklist item X', 'set a due date on checklist item X'. Updates one checklist item state, name, due date, reminder, member, or position. For viewing items use list_checklist-item.
set_checklist: Answers 'rename this checklist', 'change checklist position'. Updates checklist name or position only. For checklist items and card use get_checklist.
set_list: Answers 'rename this list', 'move this column to position 2', 'archive list X', 'unarchive list X'. Updates list name, board, position, closed flag, or subscription. For current list details use get_list.
